allocation.calendar: Weekdays; paper uses BDay, without exchange holiday adjustments.

provenance.history_caveat: Research bootstrap preserves its publication rules and CPI vintages; frozen PPP calibration uses latest-vintage 1971–2010 CPI. Market history uses the paper’s +1 business-day availability assumption, not strict H.10 release timing.

methodology.name: Two-layer allocation · revision 18
methodology.fv_definition: Signal fair value = exp(raw OLS log FV + trailing 252bd residual mean). Bands are ±1 trailing residual standard deviation, not confidence intervals.
methodology.cpi_policy: Bootstrap retains research vintages. New CPI values use their first fetch date; FRED latest-vintage data is not ALFRED. Frozen PPP calibration is never refitted.
limitations: Public daily fixings; this is not an intraday quote feed.
Historical market availability assumes +1 business day; strict H.10 weekly timing reduced the paper IR from 0.50 to 0.38.
Historical observations may be revised by providers. The last 14 days of daily inputs are refreshed; new CPI revisions are first-seen events.
Paper: full-period IR 0.50; 2019 onward IR 0.04; DSR 0.32 after 261 trials. A valuation tilt, not established alpha.
